description: This file is an implementation of the AppDelegate class for an iOS application built with React Native. It configures app launch behavior, URL sourcing for development and production, disables URL caching, clears web cache on version updates, and sets up security pinning with TrustKit.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: An iOS application delegate implementing initialization, cache management, URL sourcing, and security pinning for a React Native app.

methods.name: application:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:
methods.description: Handles app launch, sets initial properties, and calls configuration routines.

methods.name: sourceURLForBridge:
methods.description: Returns the URL for the JavaScript bundle depending on whether in debug or release mode.

methods.name: concurrentRootEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether React 18 concurrent root feature is enabled.

methods.name: disableUrlCache
methods.description: Disables the URL cache for network requests.

methods.name: clearWebEditorCache
methods.description: Clears cache data for web views upon app version updates.

methods.name: configurePinning
methods.description: Configures SSL pinning using TrustKit for specific domains.
